description: This file defines the 'Element' class within the Goteo\'Library\NormalForm namespace, implementing form element behavior with rendering and property management.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties, rendering capabilities, and array access implementation.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.description: Initializes the Element object with provided data, sets children, type, and view.

methods.description: Returns the view path for rendering the element.

methods.description: Returns the type string based on class name.
